---
title: Fish Ravioli in Fish Broth
id: MAR-0093
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g all-purpose flour
- 350 g frozen hake fillet with skin
- 100 g ricotta
- 1 l fish stock
- 1 egg
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. To prepare the pasta, arrange the flour with a pinch of salt in a fountain shape, pour 1 dl of water into the center and knead until you get a smooth and homogeneous mixture.
2. Steam the hake fillet for 10 minutes, then chop it, collect it in a bowl, add the ricotta passed through a sieve, the egg, pepper and salt.
3. Mix the ingredients to combine them.
4. Roll out the pasta and with a small cutter cut out many discs with a diameter of 4 cm.
5. Place a teaspoon of filling on each pasta disc and close them into half-moons by pressing along the edges.
6. Cook the ravioli in the fish stock and serve them in deep plates.
